name: Recon: sourcemap -> .env -> .git history -> bucket -> cloud keys
goal: Walk the artifact ladder from client-side source disclosure to usable cloud credentials and data buckets.
preconditions: Any one exposed artifact class on any live host.
impact: Application source, secrets in history, cloud keys -> resource access; public buckets -> data plane.

steps.purpose: Restore original source from .map files — endpoints, comments, and leftover keys.
steps.on_success: Extract endpoint list + any embedded creds; feed endpoints into other chains.
steps.on_fail: No maps -> step 2 (.env) and step 3 (.git) directly.

steps.purpose: Live environment config: DB DSNs, mail creds, cloud keys.
steps.on_success: Key triage: which creds are cloud vs app-internal.
steps.on_fail: No .env -> git history next; .DS_Store/.svn siblings for directory naming.

steps.purpose: Full source history incl. deleted secrets (old keys often still valid).
steps.on_fail: No .git -> backup archives (web/Backup archive misplacement exposure) and phpinfo/actuator env as alternates.

steps.purpose: Use bucket names recovered from source/env to reach the data plane.
steps.on_fail: Bucket names unknown -> brute from org naming conventions; note documented gap (needs wordlist tool).

recon.name: Artifact dictionary sweep
recon.how: Fixed path list per host; diff 404 vs 403 vs 200.

recon.name: Map-file probe
recon.how: For every .js: request .js.map; also check webpack devtool leaks in bundle comments.

recon.name: GitHub org mining
recon.how: GitHub code search on the org name and domains for leaked keys and configs.
recon.tooling: github search + gitleaks/trufflehog on found repos

recon.name: Dir-name recovery from .DS_Store
recon.how: Recover hidden directory names from .DS_Store/.svn before brute-forcing paths.
recon.tooling: web/.DS_Store mac resource exposure, web/.svn working-copy wc.db exposure

recon.name: Diagnostics pages
recon.how: phpinfo/actuator env/heapdump print env vars including keys — alternate artifact class.
recon.tooling: web/phpinfo diagnostic page exposed, redteam/Spring Boot actuator env leak

pivot_hints: cloud keys -> aws-imds-full-takeover narrative for impact framing
sourcemap endpoints -> param fuzzing on fresh surface

sources: HackerOne disclosure write-ups on artifact exposure
